def:typed-multiplicity.title: Typed multiplicity algebra

lem:multiplicity-factorization.title: Multiplicity-one incidence factorization
lem:multiplicity-factorization.note: Under the multiplicity-one hypothesis (every carrier intertwiner is uniquely a scalar multiple of D) an operator Y equivariant under L_q (x) 1 and R_q (x) 1 factorizes uniquely as Y = D (x) F. Matches the lemma with the typed symmetry given as an indexed family of matrix pairs.

thm:edge-commutant.title: Exact edge-commutant reconstruction
thm:edge-commutant.note: For a block family R (the form supplied by the trinity theorem) and nonzero typed carriers D_e, commuting with every loaded edge D_e (x) F_e and its adjoint is equivalent to the typed multiplicity equations on every edge of the graph, hence A_act' = M_type. prop:compact-mosco-resolvent.note: Partial: under cofinal Mosco convergence of operator-graph energies with weak resolvent equations and a compact graph-screen tail (the rendering of asymptotic compactness), the transported resolvents converge in operator norm, the limit resolvent is compact, the kernel-cluster Riesz projections converge in norm and their ranks are eventually equal (also for any isolated nonzero cluster via the one-shift spectral-gap file). Missing: the ordered eigenvalue convergence λ_{k,X} → λ_{k,∞} with multiplicity for every fixed index is not formalized.

thm:cofinal-duality.title: Compact-Mosco cofinal spacetime--gauge duality
thm:cofinal-duality.note: Proved for screened finite joint-commutator families c_X transported into one infinite-dimensional carrier: the protected projections P_X (range inside Ker ℒ_X, rank = dim Ker of the limit) converge in operator norm to the limit Riesz kernel projection, eventually range P_X = Ker ℒ_X = {X : [c_{j,X},X]=0 ∀j} (C*(c_X)' = M_X), the attained first positive eigenvalue of ℒ_X converges to μ_∞>0, a uniform half-gap holds eventually, and the coercivity/no-soft-mode consequence follows. Scoped hypotheses differ in form from (H1)–(H4): Mosco convergence is rendered as strong resolvent convergence on a dense source set toward a bounded limit operator A with Ker A = M_∞, asymptotic compactness as compact graph-screen tails, and H is assumed infinite-dimensional.

thm:coupled-schur.title: Universal coupled source quotient
thm:coupled-schur.note: DOWNGRADED 2026-09-22: the cited file(s) CoupledSourceSchurNaturality.lean do not compile against the pinned Mathlib and are excluded from the public tree; pending repair. Original assessment: Proved for finite source matrices S_g, S_i with G_g = S_g^*S_g positive definite: G_{i|g} = G_i − C G_g^{-1} C^* = S_i^*(I−P_g)S_i, the boxed block LDL^* factorization, G_{i|g} ⪰ 0, rank(joint Gram) − rank G_g = rank G_{i|g} (ii), the joint Gram is positive definite iff G_{i|g} ≻ 0 (i), and the source-minimal internal variation space is defined as E_i / Ker G_{i|g} (iii).

prop:classical-compatibility.title: Classical compatibility of the stabilized dual branch
prop:classical-compatibility.note: Proved at the paper's level of abstraction: the (C1)–(C3) packet is a RegulatorPacket (sectorwise convergence of the matter, metric and Ward first variations along a cofinal subsequence with vanishing common-action and Ward defects) together with the identifications of the limiting gravitational variation with χ·⟨G+Λg, ·⟩ and of the renormalized stress variation with −½⟨T, ·⟩ on determining test panels; the conclusion is the scalar matter Euler equation, 2χ(G+Λg)=T distributionally and stress conservation. The trailing clause (limiting matter fields carry the stabilized multiplicity algebra) is the conclusion of thm:cofinal-duality's Lean theorem. Scoped: the Einstein–Hilbert/Palatini and Yang–Mills–Higgs–Dirac–Yukawa first variations enter as the abstract limit functionals of (C1)–(C2), not as concrete PDE expressions.

lem:flat-word-span.title: Flat extension of a finite word span
lem:flat-word-span.note: Partial: for a nested Krylov chain K_r under one operator T, rank K_{r+1} ≤ rank K_r forces K_{r+1} = K_r and, given T-invariance of K_r, K_s = K_r for all s ≥ r; the first plateau of a forward-mapped chain is proved T-invariant. Missing: the multi-letter word-span version (every letter of the alphabet preserves V_r at any flat depth, not only the first plateau) and the constancy of external isotypic multiplicities.

prop:det-incidence.title: Determinant-incidence line

Scoped: the fully alternating line is defined as the image of Θ, so the inverse-isomorphism clause reduces to the retraction identity.

thm:finite-action-identities.title: Finite Ward, BRST, and stress identities
thm:finite-action-identities.note: Partial: the four-term face/edge/vertex action is defined with definitional one-cell locality, its exact gauge invariance is derived from covariance of the cell densities (taken as hypotheses), the Ward identity D_U^*J + R^*E = 0 and the stress transfer L_q^*T = 2L_Φ^*E are derived by the chain rule from invariance of a generic finite action along gauge/relabeling flows, and a finite (group-cochain) BRST differential is proved nilpotent through ghost degree two. Missing: gauge covariance of the concrete Yang–Mills–Higgs–Dirac–Yukawa densities is assumed, the ghost-field BRST operator s (sc=−c², sU=c_tU−Uc_s, ...) with s²=0 in all degrees and sS=0 is not the formalized object, and the cutoff-independence of the support radius is only the definitional locality.

cor:internal-vacuum.title: Stationary internal vacuum
cor:internal-vacuum.note: Proved: for the concrete regulated Standard-Model action (nonnegative couplings, unit reference doublet h₀) every directional derivative along every affine field line vanishes at the invariant vacuum U=I, H=v_H h₀, Ψ=Ψ̄=0, and the stabilizer of the nonzero reference weak doublet inside S(U(3)×U(2)) (kernel of the product determinant) is canonically isomorphic to U(3). Scoped: the stabilizer is computed for the reference doublet (0,1) (any v_H>0 h₀ is gauge equivalent); the cosmetic identification U(3) ≅ (SU(3)×U(1)_em)/Z3 is not separately formalized.

lem:mosco-strong-resolvent.title: Mosco convergence gives strong transported resolvents

Scoped: Mosco convergence is required after every cofinal reindexing (CofinalMoscoConverges) and the forms are graph energies of closed operators.

lem:collective-compactness.title: Asymptotic compactness gives collective compactness

Missing: the derivation from the paper's form-level asymptotic compactness (sequential compactness of form-bounded sequences) is not formalized.

lem:collective-norm.title: Collectively compact self-adjoint convergence is norm convergence

Scoped: symmetry of the limit is listed as a hypothesis in the primed version (it follows trivially from strong convergence) and the unprimed version takes compactness of T as input.

prop:protected-kernel-locking.title: Protected-kernel locking

Scoped: the gap-convergence clause is formalized for joint-commutator families only, not for an arbitrary closed form.
